description: Essential Fish Habitat Mapper is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Fisheries. The EFH (Essential Fish Habitat) Mapper is a one-stop tool for viewing the spatial representations of fish species, their life stages, and important habitats. The site also provides links to supporting materials, including fishery management plans, and the ability to download GIS data. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
